items.claim: Ian Garry presents a difficult stylistic matchup for Islam Makhachev due to his length, range, movement, and ability to avoid being held down.
items.quote: I think that stylistically, Ian Garry is a pretty bad match-up for him, to be honest. He's long, rangy, moves really well. You don't often see him getting taken down and held there.

items.claim: Ian Garry has low wear and tear with minimal damage and miles on the clock.
items.quote: He's not had a, you know, loads of damage or anything like that. He's not got a lot of miles on the clock.

items.claim: Once Islam Makhachev gets a hold of his opponents, they are unable to escape.
items.quote: Once he gets hold of you, you're done.

items.claim: Multiple fighters report that Islam Makhachev is exceptionally physically strong.
items.quote: People are saying there's reports across the board that he's the strongest person that people have ever fought. Apparently, he's so physically strong
